title: The Rights of Children over Their Parents in Tarbiyah and Din

text_simplified: This text addresses the rights of children over their parents from a religious and tarbiyah (upbringing) perspective. It explains the duties of parents, such as choosing a righteous mother, raising their children with akhlaq (moral character), and teaching them salah. It also emphasizes the importance of justice among children and protecting them from evils.

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'الآباء' specifically means fathers, not parents. The duty of choosing a righteous mother is a father's duty, so translating as 'parents' incorrectly includes mothers and broadens the meaning.
The term 'Din' is transliterated in the title but translated as 'religious' in the text_simplified, creating inconsistent handling of the same Arabic word within the document.
